summary: Track AIPAC reported in September 2026 that Villegas recognizes the genocide in Gaza and pledged to oppose military aid to Israel. CAIR Action endorsed him for the general election, and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally. As a school board member, he signed a ceasefire letter to the White House in January 2024. Pro-Israel spenders DMFI PAC and UDP-funded 314 Action Fund ran ads against him, and the Stop arming Israel group listed him as endorsed in October 2026.
